analysis.title: Tactile Desk Editorial Hero
analysis.notes: An overhead still-life hero combines a paper message, cutting mat, stationery, plant leaves, computer mouse, and financial documents into a tactile editorial composition. Large dark-green serif typography is centered on the paper, while bright green script creates a memorable visual accent against the warm wood and deep green surroundings.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create an overhead editorial web hero scene on a warm wooden desk, centered around a slightly off-white sheet of paper on a deep green gridded cutting mat. Surround it with translucent green pens, a white computer mouse, clipped paper documents, scattered paper clips, a small leafy houseplant, and soft natural shadows from foliage. Use tactile photography, imperfect object placement, subtle paper wrinkles, rich forest greens, warm amber wood, and an off-white focal area. Leave generous clear space on the central paper for large elegant serif headline typography and a small vivid green handwritten accent. Add a restrained dark pill-shaped navigation bar along the bottom edge.
